fields.System.Title: INB-2 — Physical receiving
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Record what actually arrived — including all the ways it differs from what was expected — and
turn it into stock.

Scope

In. Starting a receipt, recording quantities, batch and expiry and serial capture, short
and over receipt, damage, confirmation, idempotency, blind receipt, shelf life rejection.

Out. Putaway — that is [INB-3](INB-3-putaway.md). Quality inspection decisions — that is
[INB-402](../../stories/INB/INB-402-quality-hold.md).

Design notes

INB-208 is the most important story in the epic. Confirm must create stock, write
movements, close the receipt, and create putaway tasks — all in one transaction. A partial
commit means either a receipt that looks open (so it gets received again, doubling stock) or
goods on the dock with no putaway task.

INB-209 is not optional. Warehouse wifi is unreliable, operators tap twice when a spinner
hangs, and both requests arrive. Enforce the idempotency key with a unique database constraint,
not a check-then-insert — two concurrent retries both pass a check.

Stock always lands in a receiving location first. Never directly into a pick face. That
skips a control point and hides errors.

Scan determines the unit of measure. A clerk scanning a case barcode and typing a unit count
is the classic quantity error. Show the resolved UoM prominently and require confirmation.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Partial commit on confirm | [doc 09 §2.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Duplicate confirm from a scanner retry | [doc 09 §3.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Case/unit confusion on quantity entry | [doc 05 WF 1](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Batch typed with a typo, breaking FEFO later | [doc 05 WF 1](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Product not in master data, truck waiting | [doc 05 WF 1](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Damaged goods received as good | [doc 05 WF 1](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Blind receipt used to bypass tolerance controls | [doc 05 WF 2](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
